text:
deploy-bot: Canary started by @lena -> reranker-service v1.14.0 at 3% in us-central-1. Change window 25m. Release notes: https://go/release/2025-05-01. Watch p99 rerank_time and 5xx for first 12m. ID: canary-6155550001
lena: Kicking off active watch. Pause if p99 > +200ms or 5xx >0.8% sustained for 3m.
omar: Noticing a small p99 bump in us-central from 180ms -> 420ms over last 6m. p95 stable.
qa-lead: Running targeted smoke against failing slice (slice=partner-9). Quick repro: `curl -H "X-Slice: partner-9" -d @sample.json https://us-central.rerank/api` -> reproduces tail.
omar: Logs show repeated `WARN reranker: score_compute timeout=120ms` and a stack snippet: ```
  File "scoring.py", line 212, in compute_scores
    scores = model.score(batch)
  TimeoutError: scoring deadline exceeded
```
eng-release-lead: Is this limited to canary cohort?
omar: Yes, legacy hosts running v1.13.x steady at baseline. Canary hosts show the tail and occasional 502s proxied to client.
oncall-sre: Ops recommend pinning us-central to v1.13.5 and continuing rollout elsewhere. That narrows blast radius; if we keep going user percent affected could increase.
ci-bot: CI status for v1.14.0: unit tests pass, perf/regression checks flagged 1 intermittent test (tests/perf/test_rerank_tail.py)  run flaky in 2/40 runs. See: https://ci/reports/61414
qa-lead: I have a hypothesis: new scoring micro-batching changes in v1.14.0 reduce batch timeout tolerance on certain shards. If a partner sends large batched requests it can push scoring past the deadline.
lena: Quick vote: pin us-central or continue? Reply with +1 pin or +1 continue.
omar: +1 pin. Attach heap/profiles before draining.
qa-lead: +1 pin. Will add failing payloads to regression and run stress with partner-9 pattern.
eng-release-lead: +1 pin. We should also consider adjusting scoring timeout if that's a safe config change to buy time.
oncall-sre: I'll apply route-pin and set alert to page at 1.5% 5xx for 5m.
deploy-bot: Executing: `route-pin --region us-central-1 --to v1.13.5 --weight 100% --reason "scoring tail in canary"`
deploy-bot: Route update applied. us-central-1 traffic now pinned to v1.13.5 (approx 3%). Canary v1.14.0 remains active in other regions (0% additional here). Rollout ID: canary-6155550001
lena: Noted in release notes: paused us-central due to scoring tail. Link: https://go/release/2025-05-01#6155550001-notes
qa-lead: Uploading traces, heapdump, and failing payloads to RT-4652. Running fix branch with larger scoring timeouts and guarded micro-batch size.
omar: Dumps uploaded. No memory leak evident; looks like batch size + deadline mismatch.
eng-release-lead: Good. Keep global rollout halted until QA confirms fix and perf tests are green. If fix is safe, cut v1.14.1 and re-roll in same window. Reconvene +30m.
lena: Thanks everyone. For now: staged rollout partially paused, us-central pinned. Ping here if anything else. :thumbsup:
